fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on a brutal murder connected in press coverage to bookmaking, discussion of gambling and comparisons with stock-market speculation, and coverage of labor and NRA-related wage issues involving the Miami Laundry. Also reported are local politics and civic matters (including a Young Democratic Club of Dade County resolution regarding employment at Tropical Park), municipal finance topics such as a proposed state sales tax, notices for ex-service men regarding adjusted compensation applications, racing coverage and tips, and extensive nightlife/entertainment and advertising content for Miami and Miami Beach venues.
